label: Definition of the normal distribution
subgoals: Center the bell at mu with spread sigma
Mark inflection points at mu-sigma and mu+sigma

visual.title: Area under the normal curve
visual.caption: Change mu, sigma or x: the shaded left tail is P(X <= x), and the probability inside one standard deviation stays about 0.6827.

predict.question: If sigma doubles, the probability inside one standard deviation does what?
predict.explain: The band widens with the curve, so the fraction of the area it holds is unchanged; only the spread on the x axis changes.
